vanilla_changes.change: Naturally spawned mooshrooms can be brown as well as red. Config option becomeBrownChance (default 0.5) is the chance that a red mooshroom becomes brown.

editor_notes: No pack config override found for this mod, so the default 0.5 should apply. Server-side only; requires Collective.
name: Mooshroom Tweaks
summary: Lets both red and brown mooshrooms spawn naturally in mushroom fields, instead of only red ones.
